PACKMASTER-ALL_PACKS_MODE.title: All Packs mode
PACKMASTER-ALL_PACKS_MODE.hover.desc: Every pack is in the run and there is no draft. Single player only.
PACKMASTER-DRAFT_SLOTS.title: Draft slots
PACKMASTER-DRAFT_SLOTS.hover.desc: Comma-separated, in order. Each slot is a pack ID (e.g. CoreSetPack), random, choice (pick 1 of several) or none. Default: CoreSetPack,random,random,random,choice,choice,choice. Single player only; co-op always uses the default.
PACKMASTER-ALLOW_MULTIPLE_NONE.title: Allow multiple "none" slots
PACKMASTER-ALLOW_MULTIPLE_NONE.hover.des: Otherwise only the first "none" slot is empty and the others become random packs.
PACKMASTER-PACKS_PER_CHOICE.title: Packs per draft round
PACKMASTER-PACKS_PER_CHOICE.hover.desc: How many packs each "choice" slot offers.
PACKMASTER-DISABLED_PACKS.title: Disabled packs
PACKMASTER-DISABLED_PACKS.hover.desc: Comma-separated pack IDs that never appear as random packs or draft offers.
PACKMASTER-SHOW_PACK_SUMMARIES.title: Show pack ratings
PACKMASTER-SHOW_PACK_SUMMARIES.hover.des: Show each pack's ratings and tags during the draft.
PACKMASTER-DEBUG.title: Debug
PACKMASTER-SKIP_DRAFT.title: Skip the draft
PACKMASTER-SKIP_DRAFT.hover.desc: Choice slots pick a random pack instead of showing the draft.
